'''Umi-yumi''' was a [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfurous]] dessert enjoyed by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was prepared using [[Fatfish/Legends|fatfish]].
